record.field: An enquiry has arrived by telephone, email, website, referral, or reception. Confirm contact details and assign a callback before agreeing a first visit.

A real booking exists in Appointments with the patient, practitioner, agreed time and duration. Prepare reception, record attendance in the diary and agree the administrative next step after the visit.

Prepare and share the financial proposal in Sales, where the quotation's draft or sent state records its progress. Review fees and taxes, discuss arrangements with the patient and schedule a decision follow-up.
Reception is following up on the financial decision or arrangements for the next visit. Record the next action and direct clinical questions to the practitioner.

The patient and practice have agreed the next step. Confirm an accepted financial proposal in Sales when applicable, then arrange the next booking and any deposit. Closing this administrative journey does not record clinical completion or payment.
